nodes.text: Buyer chronicles a failed asking-price negotiation, retaliatory cuts, walkaway, and lessons on realtor leverage.

evidence.text: Looking for a house for almost a year. Many houses stay a looooong time; some gone in usually 1-2 days. Cast: N is my realtor; J is seller's realtor; C is J's partner; L is J and C's assistant.

Sunday 6pm buyer refuses another open offer: sellers had an offer each of past 3 showing days. Monday: thanks N, orders no volunteered competing-offer info and written disclosure letters henceforth. Realtors push 5-10% more to close; buyer won't pay extra 5-10%.

One week later: bet pays coffee if at/above asking, coffee owed if 10K below or lower. Two weeks later house sold 10K below asking; N buys coffee. First Wednesday house gone for waaay higher than asking.
